title: Amazon One Medical's Health AI vs a doctor through your own AI
summary: Compare Amazon One Medical cost without insurance and Health AI with a $40 FutureClinic visit, where a doctor reads your case and answers by message.
body_markdown:
## What do visits, memberships and prescriptions actually cost?


As of October 2026, Amazon Health AI is free, and "you do not need to be a Prime member or a One Medical member". One Medical's 24/7 On-Demand Care starts "from $29 for Direct Message Care or $49 for Video Care" as of October 2026, with an introductory Prime offer of "up to five free direct-message care consultations". Membership is "$99/yr for the first member" with Prime or "$199/yr" at OneMedical.com as of October 2026. One Medical bills insurance for scheduled visits only and "does not accept health insurance for One Medical membership and On-Demand Care". On-Demand Care covers ages 18 to 64 and children 2 to 11, varies by state for messaging, and excludes government payor beneficiaries.


On FutureClinic, there is no subscription required: pay $40 for the best-fit doctor, or pick a specific physician at their listed price, typically $20 to $100. Most doctors also offer an optional membership, typically $25 to $100 a month, for unlimited care with that doctor, cancel any time (capped at 100 doctor responses a month, with your single-visit fee counting toward joining).


FutureClinic sells no medicines and your doctor earns nothing extra for any prescription or test, so they never upsell a drug or lab panel. Keeping a medicine never requires a[monthly subscription](https://futureclinic.com/blog/telehealth-subscriptions-vs-paying-a-doctor-per-visit-yearly-cost) , and with no house formulary, your physician can prescribe any brand or generic medicine that fits, if your doctor decides it's right for you. Prescriptions go to the pharmacy you choose, including mail-order delivery, with a texted cash discount coupon; pharmacy insurance may cover the medicine, and FutureClinic helps with prior authorizations. One visit can cover several months of a stable medicine when the doctor judges it safe, and doctors can order discounted labs. Doctors do not prescribe controlled medicines (stimulants, benzodiazepines, opioids, testosterone, phentermine). Dermatologists who offer isotretinoin manage it by message, iPLEDGE included.


## Do you want Amazon One Medical's network or a doctor one to one?


Amazon One Medical suits you if you want Prime's introductory offer of up to five free message visits, a $29 message visit with the first available provider, over 200 US offices, insurance-billed scheduled visits, or care for a child aged 2 to 11. If all you wanted was an expert MD, DO or MBBS physician of your own, with no subscription needed and nothing attached, FutureClinic gives you that same doctor from your own AI app.


## Which states does FutureClinic cover, and how do you connect your AI?


FutureClinic works in 33 states and Washington, D.C., and your doctor must be licensed in the state you're in: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington, D.C. That list grows, so if you don't see your state listed, try anyway.


FutureClinic works with ChatGPT ([guide](https://futureclinic.com/blog/how-to-add-a-real-doctor-to-chatgpt) ), Claude ([guide](https://futureclinic.com/blog/how-to-add-a-doctor-to-claude) ), Claude Code, Codex, Grok Bot, Meta Muse and Instinct. Start from your AI app at[futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai](https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai) , or with the setup line` Set up FutureClinic for me: read https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt` . Once it's connected, make sure you instruct your AI to use FutureClinic to help find you a doctor. Otherwise, it may not know that this is what you want. Or start in any browser on[futureclinic.com](https://futureclinic.com/) ([editorial standards](https://futureclinic.com/blog/editorial-standards) ). FutureClinic is not for emergencies: call 911, or call or text 988 in a mental-health crisis.
